comment: State rows of docs/state.md the Intel GPU tester image measures, and on which device families (hw_gpu.py, hw_rows.py). A row applies to a device when its GPU IP version falls in one of the listed families (hw_l0probe.py, from `ocloc ids`). tests: device test executables that must pass; audits: the scratch audit (test_sycl_kernel_scratch) must find no kernel in scratch memory, ratchet or not; gate: cells of the parity gate's SYCL run on every fixture. tools/rc1-tester/tests/test_gpu_rows_contract.py keeps this file, the tests, the gate and docs/state.md in step.

rows.part: Xe-LP / Xe-LPG integrated GPUs (UHD 7xx, Iris Xe, Arc graphics of Meteor Lake and Arrow Lake): open
rows.closes_when: on an Xe-LP or Xe-LPG device the scratch audit finds no kernel in scratch memory, the six parity and math tests of the row pass and the parity gate reports 0 for float_motion, float_adm, float_vif and ssimulacra2

rows.part: Xe2 (Arc B-series, Lunar Lake): measured on an Arc B580 and an Arc Pro B60 on 2026-10-03 (ADR-1501); a run repeats it
rows.closes_when: the same measurements on an Xe2 device

rows.part: Xe-HPG (Arc A-series): measured on an Arc A380 before the row opened (ADR-1468); a run repeats it
rows.closes_when: the same measurements on an Xe-HPG device
